-- ============================================================
-- Update farmer: Yadagiri → Kapil Korlepara
-- Run this in the Supabase SQL editor (Dashboard → SQL Editor)
-- ============================================================

-- Step 1: Update the farmer record
UPDATE farmers
SET
  name        = 'Kapil Korlepara',
  slug        = 'kapil-korlepara'
WHERE slug = 'yadagiri';

-- Step 2: Remove any existing produce listings for this farmer
DELETE FROM produce_listings
WHERE farmer_id = (SELECT id FROM farmers WHERE slug = 'kapil-korlepara');

-- Step 3: Insert the 4 products
INSERT INTO produce_listings (farmer_id, name, emoji, method, status)
SELECT
  id AS farmer_id,
  unnest(ARRAY['Papaya',        'Bananas',       'Tomatoes',       'Ladies Finger']) AS name,
  unnest(ARRAY['🥭',            '🍌',             '🍅',              '🫑'])           AS emoji,
  'Natural'    AS method,
  'available'  AS status
FROM farmers
WHERE slug = 'kapil-korlepara';

content.text:
The login looks up your phone number from the `farmers` table in Supabase. The number you need to type is whatever phone number was stored when your farmer account was registered.

To find the registered numbers, run this in your Supabase SQL Editor:

```sql
SELECT name, phone, slug FROM farmers;
```

That will show all registered farmers and their phone numbers. Type just the 10-digit number (without `+91`) — the login code handles all formats (`91XXXXXXXXXX`, `0XXXXXXXXXX`, etc.).
